other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Tamil Nadu.
Must have passed at least the 8th standard.
General category applicants age up to 35 years; special category applicants age up to 45 years.
Family annual income should not exceed ₹5 Lakhs.
Applicant must contribute 10% of project cost for General category or 5% for Special category.
Mandatory Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training is required.
Project cost limit: up to ₹15 Lakhs for manufacturing projects and up to ₹5 Lakhs for trading/service projects.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 25% subsidy (maximum ₹2.5 Lakhs) on the project cost for setting up manufacturing, service or business enterprises.
